column1: toldi_blood_desc;The ancient bloodline that has ruled the Visegrad Empire ever since Árpád the Conqueror united it
column2: and which traces back its origins to the legendary warrior Toldi Miklós.;;;;;;;;;;;;;x

column3: thought to be a descendant of the divine White Mare herself.;;;;;;;;;;;;;x

column1: skoropadsky_blood_desc;This character is considered a descendant of the Cossack Hetman Ivan Petr Skoropadsky
column2: an immortal Hetman distinguished from others by Gospodar
column5: lived by God's grace for several centuries and led the Cossack Sich
column6: ending his life in martyrdom at the hands of the Hungarian king.;;;;;;;;;;;;;x

column1: napoleon_bloodline_desc;One of the greatest commanders in all of the World's history
column2: the Corsican quickly rose along the military ranks to become Emperor of the French from 1804 until 1814
column3: and again in 1815. Napoleon dominated European and global affairs for more than a decade while leading France against a series of coalitions in the Napoleonic Wars. He won most of these wars and the vast majority of his battles
column4: building a large empire that ruled over continental Europe before its final collapse in 1815.;;;;;;;;;;;;;x

column1: bloodline_desc_glorian;A true heir to the vacant throne has been declared they and their offspring are considered by all to be the rightful heir to Albion and the Empire that Never Sets
first_king_of_bulgaria_blood_desc;This character is a descendant of the Tsar of Bulgaria - Konstantin I the Liberator
column2: who at the end of the 25th century liberated Bulgaria from Turkish tyranny and became the first post-event Tsar of Bulgaria.;;;;;;;;;;;;;x

column1: le_bon_chevalier_desc;This character is a descendant of Le Bon Chevalier: a Basque folk hero and one of Louis Laflamme's closest companions until he declared himself the successor of Christ himself. At that time
column2: Le Bon Chevalier departed with half of his knights and liberated the Basque country from the rule of King Aimar
column3: who had likely murdered his father several years earlier and married the new Basque queen
column4: becoming the ancestor of a new ruling family in the former Kingdom of Navarre.;;;;;;;;;;;;;x

column1: snow_queen_desc;A legendary sorceror-queen of old whose sons would go on to found mighty kingdoms. Many of the noble clans of Scandinavia therefore claim descent from her.;;;;;;;;;;;;;x
sonderborg_desc;The first Folketro king of Denmark who for a time broke the hegemony of the Lutheran lords there.;;;;;;;;;;;;;x
demetrios_ghazi_bloodline_desc;The Kypriot founders of the Turkish empire
column2: whose rule benefited to all faiths of the Empire alike.;;;;;;;;;;;;;x

column1: sarikaya_bloodline_desc;Furkan Sarikaya was the faithful general of Demetrios Ghazi
column2: whose descendants ruled ably over Karadeniz for centuries and even held the imperial throne of Turkey at one point.;;;;;;;;;;;;;x

column1: demetrios_ghazi_bloodline_desc;The Kypriot founders of the Turkish empire
column2: whose rule benefited to all faiths of the Empire alike.;;;;;;;;;;;;;x

column1: torkashvand_bloodline_desc;House Torkashvand claims descent from Ferhad Torkashvand
column2: legendary liberator of Kermanshah and a reputed mazhariyyat of the current epoch.;;;;;;;;;;;;;x

column1: al_saud_bloodline_desc;The House of Saud descend from Muhammad bin Saud
column2: founder of the First Saudi State
column3: a mighty kingdom that stretched from Hejaz to Bahrain

column1: visvaldis_bloodline_desc;Matiss (Visvaldis) Lacplesis brought the Baltics together into a common realm. His empire would be ruled by his progeny for over a century
column2: which is still recalled by many as a golden era for both the Baltics and Christendom.;;;;;;;;;;;;;x
